title: Censura y persecución
goal: Read how these regimes' quieter, everyday campaign against expression worked -- press censorship, book burning, blacklists, university purges, and exile.
grammar: Con el fin de: expresar un propósito

items: Explain why regimes imposed official censors on the press.
Describe what happened to books and songs considered subversive.
Explain how blacklists affected careers and led to self-censorship.
Describe how the persecution reached the universities.
Use con el fin de to express a purpose.
